claims.value: Male figure, cut from a block of reddish brown wood. Eyes formed of rings of bone, once containing pupils of obsidian. Spine is in relief and the vertebrae are indicated by transverse lines.
Height: 70 centimetres Width: 12.50 centimetres Depth: 13 centimetres
Presented by A.W. Franks Esq. 3 April 1893, who had purchased it from Miss Cutter.
Register slip comment: "Easter Island. cf. Report of US Nat. Mus. 1889. Thomson. pl.L."
